findings.note: Game log: 3 assists in 5 games (2 on Oct 3, 1 on Oct 8), none in 3 of 5, 17:14 avg TOI. RotoWire puts him on the 3rd line and 2nd PP unit, a smaller role than in past years. No Oct 12 lineup, goalie or Devils injury news found to confirm his spot.

Oct 6 projected lineup has Giroux on the 3rd line with Amadio and Pinto, behind the Stutzle and Cozens lines. Jake Sanderson, Artem Zub and Linus Ullmark were out injured, which could cut into Ottawa's PP and overall scoring.
